title: Sell Mineral Rights in Clinton, AR
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Clinton, AR | Van Buren County
metaDescription: Own gas royalty rights near Clinton, Arkansas, the Van Buren County seat? We evaluate core Fayetteville Shale interests and make a straightforward cash offer.
heroLead: Clinton is the Van Buren County seat and sits inside the structural core of the Fayetteville Shale, where well results were consistently stronger than the play's eastern flank.
intro: Van Buren County was one of the handful of counties that carried the Fayetteville Shale during its peak years, and Clinton's courthouse holds the deed and lease records for most of that activity. If you own minerals here, there's a reasonable chance the interest is tied to a well that actually produced meaningful volumes, at least in its early years, rather than a lease that was signed and then went nowhere.

sections.heading: Core-play production history around Clinton
paragraphs: Wells drilled in and around Clinton during the 2005 to 2012 window generally performed better than those on the play's flank counties, reflecting Van Buren County's position closer to the thickest, most productive part of the shale. That history is a real asset, even though most of these wells are now well past their peak output and producing at a fraction of their original rate.

sections.heading: From Southwestern Energy to BKV Corporation
paragraphs: Southwestern Energy, operating as SEECO, drilled most of the original wells in this area. It sold its Fayetteville Shale position to Flywheel Energy in 2018, and BKV Corporation acquired that position in 2021. If the name on your royalty statement has changed over the years, that's the reason, not an indication anything is wrong with your interest.
We check current operator filings directly rather than relying on whatever name last appeared on a statement, since ownership of the operating position has moved more than once.

sections.heading: Van Buren County Circuit Clerk records
paragraphs: Clinton's courthouse holds the recorded leases, deeds, and division orders for the county. We use those records to confirm ownership as part of any offer, which is often faster than reconstructing a family's chain of title from memory.

faqs.question: Is Van Buren County part of the core Fayetteville Shale play?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's one of the counties at the structural core of the play, generally with stronger well results than the eastern flank counties like White.

faqs.question: Why has the operator name on my royalty statement changed over the years?
faqs.answer: Southwestern Energy sold its Fayetteville Shale assets to Flywheel Energy in 2018, which were then acquired by BKV Corporation in 2021. That's the most common reason for a name change.

faqs.question: Our well near Clinton has declined a lot since it was first drilled. Is that normal?
faqs.answer: Yes, Fayetteville Shale wells decline steeply in their first few years and then settle into a long, low-volume tail, which is where most legacy wells sit today.
